messages:
AuditorJane: Hi team — SOC 2 auditor here. We need the API error log bundle + KMS/HSM audit export for INC-20260212-17 (window: 2026-02-12 03:40–04:10 UTC). Also need billing correlation and chain-of-custody evidence (checksums, who exported). Control refs: CC6.1, CC7.3.

Matt: Got it. Is this the latency spike tied to INC-20260212-17? Which artifacts should we prioritize?

AuditorJane: Yes. Prioritize API gateway error logs, keystore audit exports, request traces (x-request-id) and billing export for that window. Chain-of-custody needs who pulled files and sha256 sums.

Sara: Pulling triage notes now. We have a support timeline and preliminary repro steps. I can stage everything into the evidence bucket: s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/2026-02-12/INC-20260212-17/ — will we share presigned links?

Kevin: I will generate presigned URLs for the API gateway logs and the keystore audit export. Will redact PII. ETA ~30m. KMS rotation record: last rotation 2026-01-15, active key id rk-key-9a7f.

Matt: I'll drop billing export (raw CSV) and the request-trace bundle (trace ids) into the same folder. Noting retries from certain client IP ranges correlate with token auth failures which caused retry storms.

AuditorJane: For chain-of-custody include: filename, sha256, who exported, timestamp, and a signed manifest (GPG). Also need confirmation which retention policy applied (policy version).

Kevin: Will include sha256 and a GPG-signed manifest. Exported by kevin_infra. Retention policy v2.4 was in effect since 2025-11-01. Internal policy doc: https://redwood.internal/policy/data-retention-v2.4

Sara: Support timeline uploaded (will post link). Repro notes: replay payloads via curl to /v1/generate with malformed auth header to reproduce 401->retry loop. Example (no secrets):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer INVALID' -d '{"prompt":"test"}'
```

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-02-12T03:35Z - rollout v1.12.4 to inference-hosts (sha: a1b2c3).

AuditorJane: Great. Once uploads are available post the presigned URLs and the manifest sha256 here and confirm that no lifecycle deletion ran during the window. We will download and verify integrity.

Kevin: Presigned URLs created: https://s3-presigned.redwood.aws/redwood-evidence/INC-20260212-17/api-logs.gz?X-Amz-Signature=... and https://s3-presigned.redwood.aws/redwood-evidence/INC-20260212-17/kms-audit.json?X-Amz-Signature=...
manifest sha256: 9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08 (GPG-signed by kevin_infra). No lifecycle deletions in that prefix between 2026-01-01 and 2026-03-01.

Sara: Uploaded support_timeline_INC-20260212-17.pdf -> https://redwood.internal/files/abc123 (access controlled). Billing export: https://redwood.internal/files/billing-INC-20260212-17.csv

Matt: Confirmed billing csv aligns with charge spike at 03:42–03:58 UTC, matches request retries in traces. I'll coordinate with finance for annotated invoice notes.

AuditorJane: Thanks — we'll validate and follow up if anything mismatches. If you can add the exact user/account IDs we redacted off the public links (in a separate secured note), that would help with correlation.

Kevin: Will add a secure note with redacted account IDs and include it in the signed manifest.

Sara: Noted. Closing loop shortly and will ping when the evidence packet is finalized. :thumbsup:
